identity: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted JSON observation

tags.ordinary_map_keys: V maps validate and retain every key, including constructor/prototype names.
tags.native_path_presence: Forward paths follow existing map keys and integer array indices; no truthiness, simulated properties or missing-path exceptions.
tags.explicit_boolean_conversion: Boolean conversion accepts documented scalars, collections or an explicit typed provider; arbitrary structs and Dates are unsupported.
tags.native_float_spelling: Numeric observations contain a JavaScript-specific float spelling; native rounding is tested independently at the bit level.
tags.scalar_string_length: String length counts Unicode scalar values rather than UTF-16 code units.
tags.whole_character_diagnostics: Native prefix/suffix diagnostics retain whole Unicode characters.
tags.native_string_order: Native UTF-8 string ordering differs from UTF-16 ordering.
tags.native_map_order: Native maps retain insertion order rather than JavaScript numeric-key ordering.
tags.native_container_json: Native structs/containers serialize their own fields; Functions/Futures require an explicit JSON value.
tags.native_indentation: Native integer/string indentation is not clipped to ten UTF-16 units.
tags.native_calendar_range: Native calendar validation uses its documented range rather than JavaScript TimeClip.
tags.nonempty_numeric_text: Empty numeric input is invalid instead of coercing to zero.
tags.signed_zero_spelling: Native numeric output retains negative zero.
tags.native_value_spelling: Collections use native value representations and signed zero is retained.
tags.explicit_scalar_conversion: Null/collections are not implicit numeric inputs; empty numeric text is invalid.
tags.explicit_date_conversion: Date conversion requires ISO text, a native Date, epoch milliseconds or a typed provider.
tags.native_date_projection: Dates retain native precision/projection rather than JavaScript object coercion behavior.
tags.native_whitespace: V Unicode whitespace differs from ECMAScript whitespace; numeric rounding is not involved.
